title: Cumulative Frequency and Ogives — Statistics
hook: Let's explore Cumulative Frequency and Ogives from the chapter on Statistics. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Cumulative Frequency and Ogives An ogive (cumulative frequency curve) is plotted using cumulative frequencies. 'Less than' and 'more than' ogives can be used to find the median graphically. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 'Less than' ogive: plot upper limits vs cumulative frequency (rising curve)
💡 'More than' ogive: plot lower limits vs cumulative frequency (falling curve)
💡 Median = x-coordinate where the two ogives intersect
💡 Can also find median by drawing n/2 line on a single ogive
